<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1"><!--[if !supportLists]-->1.<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</span><!--[endif]-->The proposal, by reason of the site being
located within an area of land liable to flooding and the lack of a
comprehensive Flood Risk Assessment, due to a lack of flood maps&nbsp;addressing the local surface water flood zone and flood
mitigation measures which take into account compensatory flood storage details,
has failed to demonstrate that the proposed development would not exacerbate
the risk of flooding within the site or increase the risk and consequences of
flooding elsewhere, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024),
Policies SI12 and SI13 of The London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1.U of Harrow Core
Strategy (2012) and Policies DM9 and DM10 of the Harrow Development Management Polices
Local Plan (2013).<o:p></o:p></p>
description: Relocation of entrance door to front elevation, Single and two storey side to rear extension, External alterations (Demolition of side porch, conservatory at side and outbuilding at rear)
